faq.q: What is the origin of Tayfun?
faq.a: Tayfun is associated with Arabic. Tayfun is the Turkish form of Arabic طُوفَان (Ṭūfān), meaning 'typhoon, storm'.
Yes — the underlying form طَائِفُون is Arabic.
Tayfun can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Tayfun should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Ṭūfān is not a Quranic personal name.
